reader: an intelligent adult who is not a specialist in the field

levels.name: Grounding
levels.does: names a concept and shows what it is, defining any term it uses

levels.name: Mechanism
levels.does: explains how or why, step by step or with a simple model
levels.example: how Bayes' theorem updates a belief

levels.name: Specialist
levels.does: a method, a limitation, a debate, or reasoning with numbers
levels.example: why priors dominate with small samples

levels.name: Frontier
levels.does: open questions and competing theories, in technical detail
